meta.fireModeNote: Verified in code: every non-melee weapon fires continuously as long as the mouse button is held (gated only by fireCooldown = 1/fireRate), with NO real automatic-vs-semi-automatic-vs-bolt-action distinction implemented - a pistol or sniper rifle here can be held down and will keep firing exactly like an AR/SMG. The only behavioral fire-mode difference that actually exists in code is burst (burstCount>1) vs this default hold-to-fire-repeatedly behavior. Categories/weapons that would traditionally be semi-auto or bolt-action (Pistol, Revolver, Sniper, DMR, Shotgun aside from the fire-rate cap) are NOT enforced as such.
